faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about payroll portage
faq.answer1: Payroll portage is a three-way contractual relationship between a freelancer (ported employee), a portage company, and a client company. It allows independent consultants to benefit from employee status while maintaining their professional autonomy.
faq.answer2: The freelancer finds their mission, negotiates their daily rate with the client company. The portage company handles all administrative management: invoicing, social contributions, payslips, and pays a salary to the consultant after deducting management fees (typically 5-10%).
faq.question3: What are the advantages of payroll portage?
faq.answer3: Payroll portage offers many advantages: complete social coverage (social security, retirement, unemployment), administrative simplification, no need to create a company, professional support, and the ability to focus on your core business without managing accounting.
faq.question4: How to calculate my daily rate in payroll portage?
faq.answer4: The daily rate is calculated based on your desired salary, social charges (approximately 45%), portage company management fees (5-10%), and professional expenses. Our free simulator allows you to accurately calculate your daily rate in just a few clicks.
faq.question5: What is the difference between payroll portage and self-employed?
faq.answer5: In payroll portage, you are an employee with all social benefits (unemployment, full retirement, insurance). As self-employed, you are independent with minimal social protection. Portage is better suited for long missions and high daily rates, while self-employed status is suitable for small activities with limited revenue.
faq.question6: How to choose the best portage company?
faq.answer6: Compare management fees (typically 5-10%), included services (support, professional liability insurance, health insurance), support responsiveness, customer reviews, and financial stability. Our platform allows you to compare several personalized offers for free according to your profile.
